title: Rooney at Euro 2004 v Yamal at the same age
checked: Dates of birth: Rooney 24 Oct 1985, Yamal 13 Jul 2007; Rooney's last Euro 2004 game (24 Jun 2004) = 18 years 8 months, Yamal hit the same age on 13 Mar 2026. Rooney's nine England goals by then with cap numbers (two v Switzerland, two v Croatia at Euro 2004; seventeenth cap v Portugal) from his goals list; Yamal's goals with cap numbers (goal 1 cap 1, goal 2 cap 3, goal 3 cap 13 v France at Euro 2024, goal 4 cap 19, goals 5-6 cap 20 v France June 2025, goal 7 June 2026) from his goals list and article. Euro 2024 win from Spain/UEFA records. Assists and minutes for international games could not be confirmed, so the twist uses games. Yamal's exact cap count on 13 Mar 2026 not stated (not confirmable).

lines.text: Euro twenty oh-four. An eighteen-year-old from Everton terrifies the whole of Europe.
Wayne Rooney scored twice against Switzerland, then twice more against Croatia.
Then he broke a bone in his foot against Portugal, and England went out on penalties.
On that last day he was eighteen years and eight months old.
So where was Lamine Yamal at exactly the same age? That's March twenty twenty-six.
Six goals for Spain. Fewer than Rooney's nine.
But Yamal already had the thing Rooney never won. A European Championship.
And that scream of a goal against France made him the youngest scorer in Euros history. Sixteen years old.

scene.heading: EURO 2024 SEMI-FINAL
scene.body: Yamal scores against France, four days before his 17th birthday. Rooney had briefly held that record in 2004.

lines.text: Now the twist. Same number of games.
After seventeen caps, Rooney had nine goals. Yamal had three.
Rooney was the finisher. Yamal is the creator. Different jobs, different numbers.
So who was the better eighteen-year-old? Rooney or Yamal? Tell me in the comments.
